criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: 1, 3, 6 and 7 strong. 5 a mannequin sleeve with a doll hand, sheet overhanging the edge; 8 low poly faceless figures; 9 a mannequin walker; 4 a laptop on a blown white top against a navy void, off its CRAFT PLAN, 21 px title.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One hero on every frame, one night lawn and west key, the inlay changes state; 4 a void and 8's figures match nothing else.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and the pavers were counted. c19's label is most naturally an access label on a gated PDF nobody opened; frame 4 renders it as 'a faculty and staff document' and the web edition as 'written for faculty and staff', set beside 'first-ever'. Minor: copy.json S4 body lacks a sentence; an aggregates note says '1,000 desks per student'.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who built it, where, the missing adopting body and dated next steps; 79,000 is scale without consequence.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Plain cover; 2 pays; turn at 4; 5 re-quotes rule three; 8 returns after 7 ends the walk; the close lands on an action.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Restrained and specific; house rules clean; disclaimers read like a machine talking to itself.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Fresh subject and instrument; one object per day repeats nos. 46 and 41; the isotype field repeats no. 43; follows no. 47's beat.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild 5, 8 and 9 without mannequins, put 4 back on the lawn, and rewrite frame 4's dek to 'a staff-only PDF titled ...'.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Mannequin sleeve with a doll hand pointing; the sheet overhangs the edge into the void.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Tight crop of two hands on the keyboard, sleeves cut at the wrist, the sheet flat on the desk with a contact shadow.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Low poly faceless figures read as game NPCs; the hero desk cropped and flat lit.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Remove the figures; empty chairs raked by the window's last light toward the lectern; the hero's lid the only practical.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Mannequin walker with a smeared head, feet straddling the paver edge.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Drop the figure; a single long cast shadow of an off-frame person across the pavers toward the desk.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Laptop on a blown white top against a navy void; a 21 px title.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera back to eye 1.0 m with the lawn and seam beyond the lid; desk top exposure down; title at 24 px or larger.
